dispatch_contract_version.description: Frozen as of B.2 (version 1); bumped to version 2 in B.2.1; bumped to version 3 in B.2.2 -- see docs/_machine/system-atlas/README.md's 'Dispatch contract freeze' section for the full frozen interface list (Task/Wave/Lease/Dispatch Lock/Dispatch Journal/Recovery Record/Node/Edge/Shard). A breaking change to any of those interfaces' required fields, enum values, or operational/on-disk-location contract must bump this number, which downstream consumers (Lane C, Lane D integration) pin against. Version 2's change: the Dispatch Journal interface's on-disk location moved from one shared well-known path to one immutable file per transaction (closing an architect-identified ABA journal-generation race), not a change to the persisted journal record's own JSON field shape. Version 3's changes (both real breaks for a consumer that assumed the old shape/semantics, not silent): (a) the Dispatch Lock record's required fields grew host_id and process_start_identity (schema/dispatch-lock.schema.json), and reclaiming an expired lock now additionally requires machine-verified proof the previous owner is dead -- TTL expiry alone is never sufficient (closing an architect-identified stale-owner lost-update); (b) the Dispatch Journal interface's recovery path now validates full record integrity (operation/hash/target-path authority) before acting on anything read from disk, and journal publication is exclusive (a transaction_id collision is refused, never silently overwritten).

proves_no_owned_path_overlap.description: Must be derived by scripts/system-atlas/dependency-safety.mjs's analyzeWave() from an empty ownedPathOverlaps/forbiddenPathOverlaps/sharedFileConflicts set -- never hand-set to true.

proves_dependency_safe.description: Must be derived by analyzeWave() from an empty cycles/blockedByCycles set and no blocked/unresolved task in the wave -- never hand-set to true.

safety_report.description: The full analyzeWave() output this wave's two proves_* booleans were derived from, kept for auditability.

lease_states.description: This is the task lifecycle enum (see task.schema.json's status field), not the separate Lease record status enum (see lease.schema.json: ACTIVE/EXPIRED/RELEASED/COMPLETED).
